name: Jounouchi Takeru
source:
Hobbies: Cleaning (From his experience of doing housework because he has many younger brothers).
Favorite Food: (One of which is used only in the yolk 3 eggs!) Picked Mibuna, [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naan]Naan[/url], plain omelet.
Family: He's the second of eight children.

Voiced by Kondou Katsumi.
